 Activity 
 – The specific activity 
 under the work order. 
 Milestone 
 – The milestone 
 related to the activity. 
 Fill General Task Fields 
 In addition to the reference hierarchy, the user fills the same core 
 fields as a General Task (Assign To, CC, dates, priority, remarks, 
 attachments). 
 Fill Optional Reference Fields 
 Work 
 Done (Optional) – 
 Short description of the work progress or output. 
 Ref. 
 Location (Optional) – 
 Specific location where the task is to be executed, if applicable. 
 Save and Notify 
 On saving, the task appears under the Reference category on 
 the Dashboard and Task Board, and notifications are sent to the assignee 
 and CC users. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: General Task
text:
General Task 
 Mobile App > Task Management App" />
 General 
 Task 
 General shows 
 standalone tasks not linked to any work order. 
 Creating 
 a General Task (Step-by-Step) 
 Open the New Task Flow 
 From the Dashboard, tap + New Task to start creating a task. 
 Select Category – General 
 In the category selection modal, choose General . This is used 
 for tasks that are not linked to any Business Unit/Work Order structure. 
 Select Scope – Enterprise or BU 
 Choose whether the task applies at an Enterprise level (visible 
 across the organization, based on access rights) or is restricted 
 to a specific Business Unit . This helps in reporting and filtering 
 later. 
 Fill Core Fields 
 On the General Task form, provide the following details: 
 Assign 
 To (Mandatory) – 
 Select the primary user responsible for executing the task. The 
 task will appear in their My Task list. 
 CC 
 (Optional, Multi-Select) – Add other users in CC for visibility. 
 These users will see the task when they use the In CC toggle. 
 Start 
 Date & Optional Start Time – When the task is expected to begin. 
 End 
 Date & Optional End Time – When the task is expected to be 
 completed. 
 Priority 
 (Low / Medium / High) – 
 Helps in prioritizing work on the Task Board and Dashboard. 
 Remarks 
 (up to 200 characters) – Short description or instructions 
 for the assignee. 
 Attachments 
 (Camera Only) – 
 Capture a photo in real time using the device camera (no gallery 
 or file upload). 
 Duration Auto-Calculation 
 Once both the Start and End date-time values are entered, 
 the app automatically calculates and displays the duration 
 between them. This gives users a clear idea of timeline and helps 
 with planning. 
 Save the Task 
 Tap Save . The system validates that all mandatory fields, especially 
 Assign To and date-time validations (End ≥ Start), are correct. 
 On success, the task is saved and a success message (“Task 
 created successfully”) is displayed. 
 Post-Save Behaviour 
 After saving: 
 The 
 task appears under the All and Created tabs for 
 the creator. 
 It 
 appears under My Task for the assignee. 
 Any 
 CC’d users can see it via the In CC toggle. 
 Notifications 
 are sent to the Assignee and CC users with a deep link to the 
 task detail screen. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: BU Wise Task
text:
BU Wise Task 
 Mobile App > Task Management App" />
 BU Wise 
 Task 
 The Dashboard supports filters such as Business 
 Unit (for both General and Reference tasks) and Contractor 
 (for Reference tasks). 
 When the user applies filters, all counts and percentages 
 in the doughnut chart and list views are recalculated according to the 
 selected filter values. 
 BU-wise 
 Task View (Step-by-Step) 
 Open BU-wise View Screen 
 From the main navigation, open the BU-wise Task View screen. 
 This screen lists all Business Units the user has access to. 
 Review BU Cards 
 Each BU is shown as a card displaying: 
 BU 
 Name 
 Total 
 Task Count for that BU 
 There 
 may also be a special card “No Business Unit” for tasks that are 
 not mapped to any BU. 
 Drill Down into a BU 
 When the user taps on a BU card, the app opens the Task Board 
 with that BU pre-selected as a filter. The user can then further narrow 
 down tasks by status, date, or category. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Notification
text:
Notification 
 Mobile App > Task Management App" />
 Notification 
 • 
 Push Notifications 
 The app sends 
 push notifications to keep users instantly updated about important task 
 events. These alerts appear on the user’s mobile device and open the task 
 directly when tapped. 
 · Task 
 Assignment 
 You 
 receive this when a new task is assigned to you so you can start working 
 on it immediately. 
 · Added 
 as CC 
 Sent 
 when you are added as a CC on a task. You’re not responsible for completing 
 it but you can track it for visibility. Use the In CC toggle to 
 view such tasks. 
 · Task 
 Updated 
 Alerts 
 you when someone changes important details (dates, priority, remarks, 
 references) so you always stay in sync with the latest information. 
 · Status 
 Changed (Completed / Overdue) 
 Notifies 
 you when a task is marked Completed , or when it becomes Overdue 
 if the deadline has passed and it is still pending. These updates help 
 you act fast on critical tasks. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Pending Task
text:
Pending Task 
 Mobile App > Task Management App" />
 Pending 
 Task 
 1. 
 Task Board & Lists – Detailed Explanation of All / My / Self / Created 
 The 
 Pending Task Board 
 is the central place where users search, filter, and manage tasks. It 
 consists of multiple tabs and an In CC toggle. 
 Opening 
 the Task Board 
 From 
 the Dashboard or BU-wise view, navigate to Task Board . 
 The Task Board displays tasks as a list with key information like 
 title, assignee, due date/age, and status. 
 Understanding 
 the Tabs 
 a) 
 All Tasks Tab 
 The 
 All tab displays all tasks that the user is allowed 
 to view based on their role and access rights. 
 This 
 typically includes tasks created by the user, assigned to 
 the user, where the user is in CC, and other tasks within 
 the user’s authorized BU or enterprise scope. 
 It 
 is useful for managers or power users who need a complete 
 overview, not just their personal workload. 
 b) 
 My Task Tab 
 The 
 My Task tab shows only those tasks where the logged-in 
 user is the Assignee . 
 This 
 is the primary view for an individual user to see what work 
 is directly assigned to them. 
 It 
 excludes tasks where the user is just a creator or only in 
 CC, making it a focused worklist. 
 c) 
 Self Task Tab 
 The 
 Self Task tab shows tasks that the user has assigned 
 to themselves (i.e., the user is both the creator and 
 the assignee). 
 This 
 is typically used for personal follow-up tasks, reminders, 
 or activities that the user wants to track for their own work. 
 It 
 helps distinguish tasks owned entirely by the user from tasks 
 assigned by someone else. 
 d) 
 Created Task Tab 
 The 
 Created Task tab lists tasks that the logged-in 
 user has created , regardless of who the assignee is. 
 This 
 is especially useful for supervisors or coordinators who assign 
 tasks to others and want to track their progress. 
 Users 
 can review whether assignees have started, completed, or delayed 
 these tasks. 
 Using 
 the “In CC” Toggle 
 The 
 In CC toggle filters the Task Board to show only 
 tasks where the logged-in user is added as a CC . 
 When 
 the toggle is switched ON , the list is restricted to 
 CC’d tasks; when turned OFF , the Task Board returns 
 to the previously active tab’s result (All/My/Self/Created). 
 This 
 is useful for users who need to monitor tasks for awareness, 
 without being the primary assignee. 
 Search 
 and Filters on Task Board 
 Users 
 can search by task title or other searchable attributes. 
 Filters 
 are available 
 for status (Pending/Overdue/Completed), date range, Business 
 Unit, Contractor , and possibly other criteria as defined. 
 Combining 
 tabs + In CC + filters allows very granular views (for example, 
 “All Overdue tasks in BU X where I am in CC”). 
 Empty 
 State Messaging 
 If 
 no tasks are found for the applied filters and tab, the app 
 displays a friendly message: “No Pending Task found.” 
 This ensures the user understands that the system is working, 
 but there is simply no data matching the criteria. 
 2. Task Detail & Status Updates 
 Open Task Detail 
 Tap 
 any task from the Task Board list to open its Task Detail 
 screen. 
 View Information 
 The 
 detail screen shows all fields including references (for Reference 
 tasks), remarks, attachments, and current status. 
 Update by Assignee 
 The 
 Assignee can update the task’s status (e.g., mark it as 
 Completed ) and add new remarks for progress updates. 
 Edit by Creator/Admin 
 The 
 Creator or Admin can edit core fields such as dates, 
 priority, or assignment details, depending on permissions. 
 Automatic Overdue Handling 
 When 
 the End Date/time has passed and the task is still not 
 marked completed, the system automatically treats it as Overdue 
 and updates dashboard and list counts within about one minute. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: FAQ
text:
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q : How 
 to resolve the inability to select Activity during BOQ creation? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 Group and Sub Group details are provided to enable the selection of 
 activities during Bill of Quantity creation. 
 Q: How to adjust Workflow Approvals on Budget amendment? 
 Answer: W orkflow approval 
 settings for project budget amendment need rectification. 
 Adjust 
 workflow approvals to include: 
 a. BU-wise approval and 
 b. 
 Positive and negative amount approvals 
 Q: How to perform Material and Labour Debits on RA bill? 
 Answer: Create 
 Addition 
 Deduction setup from Terms & Condition 
 setup under General 
 Master . For 
 instance, set up Material and Labour separately. During RA Bill creation, 
 choose these deductions individually on the Deduction 
 tab. 
 Q: What to do when Service 
 Indent Activity is not displayed in Item Info section ? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: Item Info is concealed 
 when selecting Document Type as Project Requisition (Non Activity-wise). 
 If you later switch to Document Type Service Indent Work Order, the 
 Item Info malfunctions. 
 Solution: Delete the existing 
 entry and re-enter with the correct Document Type (Service Indent 
 Work Order) to resolve the issue with Item Info. 
 Q: How to avoid errors during BOQ Amendments? 
 Answer: 
 C ause: 
 The Resource Requirement 
 Register Report reveals two resource types: Contract Cost and Free 
 Issue Material. The Free Issue Material Cost hasn't been considered 
 in the Project Budget for this Business Unit. 
 Solution: Review 
 and add Free Issue Material Cost in the Project Budget for this Business 
 Unit to rectify the error in BOQ Amendment. 
 Q: What is a MAX EXECUTED AMOUNT? 
 Answer: The Project Budget 
 Revision considers the higher value between BOQ amount and Work Order 
 amount for MAX EXECUTED AMOUNT. 
 Q: How to avoid the validation message shown at the 
 time of Work Order Creation against Budget amounts? 
 Answer: 
 System validation prevents the creation of a work order exceeding 
 the Budget amount. 
 Q: Can discount be modified during Work Order Amendment? 
 If yes, what is the process to bring about the change ? 
 Answer: 
 Suppose you have given 
 discount 1% on basic value (Billing Term) of Main Work Order, and 
 you want to change nomenclature of discount of the above work order 
 through amendment. 
 In 
 this situation, to 
 change the nomenclature of the discount for a Main Work Order in an 
 amendment, remove both the percentage and amount of the discount and 
 then input the direct amount in the billing terms. 
 Q: How to resolve an issue where an Activity is wrongly 
 tagged for already indented quantity? 
 Answer: 
 Auto 
 Indent is not based on Document Type, which is now free. Avoid using 
 Direct Indent TOD while generating the Auto Indent to prevent incorrect 
 activity tagging. 
 Q : Warning 
 Message being displayed while editing Activity Description. What actions are to be taken to resolve this warning? 
 Answer: 
 A. If 
 you have created from Activity Master then why it is required to be 
 changed from BOQ. 
 B . If work orders are already tagged, changing 
 the description may not be possible. 
 C. If 
 the activity is not needed, remove it from BOQ. Change the description 
 in Activity Master and then re-tag it in BOQ. 
 Q : How 
 to resolve an issue where the already tagged quantity appears again for 
 selection in New Work Order? 
 Answer: 
 Issue: When creating a new Work Order from a 
 Service Indent, you may encounter a situation where the already tagged 
 quantity appears again for selection. 
 Resolution: 
 This issue arises when all the quantities against the first Work Order 
 have been consumed. To check if a Work Order has been completed for 
 the specific Service Indent: 
 Select 
 the desired activity for the new Work Order. 
 Observe 
 that no quantity is displayed, indicating that a Work Order has already 
 been executed against this Service Indent. 
 Ensure 
 to review the completed Work Order status and quantities before creating 
 a new one. 
 Q : How 
 to resolve the time out error encountered during the download of Pending 
 Service Indent (Enterprise Level) ? 
 Answer: 
 Try 
 downloading during periods of lower user activity (less active users). 
 This should help control the timeout problem. 
 Q : How 
 to resolve ‘Payment Validation’ error during RA Bill Deletion? 
 Answer: 
 The 
 system prevents the deletion of this RA Bill due to a prior payment 
 being made against it. Verify the Receipt/Payment Entry document number 
 associated with this RA Bill for reference. 
 Q : What 
 to do when a Wrong Amount is displayed in Adjustment Info of Credit Note 
 (Revised RA Bill)? 
 Answer: 
 To 
 accurately reflect the amount in the Adjustment Info of the Credit 
 Note (Revised RA Bill), ensure the gross amount from the billing terms 
 is entered and saved. 
 Q : What 
 to do if Resource wise Validation Requirement in Project Budget Import appears? 
 Answer: 
 Ensure 
 the "Auto generate from activity master" column in the sheet 
 is marked as 'N' instead of 'Y' for successful import . 
 Q : What 
 do to if Work Order Number is missing during Work Order Amendment ? 
 Answer: 
 If 
 a Work Order is short closed through Work Order Amendment, it cannot 
 be further amended. Subsequent amendments are restricted for short-closed 
 Work Orders. 
 Q : How 
 to resolve an issue where the Budget has exceeded the Allocated amount ? 
 Answer: 
 You 
 are requested to check the report from Budget vs. Actual > Budget 
 Validation Register and as well as check the resource requirement 
 register detail. 
 Further we have provided the Budget Validation 
 and Reconciliation Process Document in the following link. 
 h ttps://help.farvisioncloud.com/Engineering/Engineering/Tutorial/Budget_Validation___Reconciliation_Process.htm 
 Q : Customer 
 RA Bill Posting Showing validation message for posting ledger. How to 
 avoid this validation message? 
 Answer: 
 Ensure that the 
 required account head is set in the Billing Term Template. Configure the billing 
 terms accordingly before submitting the Customer Revised RA Bill. 
 Q : What 
 could be the reason for the Budget Head not being visible during Work 
 Order creation ? 
 Answer: 
 It 
 is likely due to the absence of a budgeted amount in the project budget 
 in contract cost. Ensure that the necessary budget head has been allocated 
 to make it appear during the work order creation process. 
 Q : Can 
 a user prepare RA bill, if a Final bill exists against the Work Order? 
 Answer: 
 Once 
 a final bill has been generated against a Work Order, it becomes unavailable 
 for further transactions. 
 Q : Resource 
 Requirement Sheet Upload Issues 
 Answer: When 
 uploading the resource requirement sheet (excel sheet), please ensure 
 the following corrections for a successful import: 
 1. For "Option type," select "Against 
 work order (Activity wise - Lumpsum)" instead of "Against 
 work order (Activity wise)-Lumpsum." 
 2. 
 I n the "Activity" 
 column, use "Ref No." instead of "Description." 
 3. 
 For "Code (For Option: Against Activity with variant)," 
 input "Ref No." (This option is unnecessary if you've selected 
 the correct option in point 1). 
 4. 
 For "Resource Type (For Option: Against Project Budget)," 
 omit this option if you've chosen the correct option in point 1. 
 Q : How to resolve the TDS Deduction Issue in QC 
 Engineering during Contractor RA Bill creation ? 
 Answer: E nsure 
 that you have set TDS Check Limit, not Transaction Check Limit, for 
 the relevant contractor under the specified company. This adjustment 
 is necessary for accurate TDS calculation. 
 Q : During 
 RA Bill Posting, a validation message for posting ledger is displayed. 
 How to avoid this validation message ? 
 Answer: Review 
 the account head mapping for the associated Budget head in the Setup. 
 Q : Is 
 it possible to save contractor RA bill without HSN being tagged ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 correct HSN tagging by selecting HSN without abetment and save the 
 RA Bill. 
 Q : What 
 could be the reason for Free Issue Material not appearing at the time 
 of creating auto indent ? 
 Answer: Verify 
 that the correct resource type "Free Issue Material" is 
 selected instead of the incorrect option. 
 Q : Can Project Budget Amendment reason 
 be edited ? 
 Answer: Once saved, 
 Project Budget Amendment reason cannot be edited. 
 For making changes to Amendment reason, 
 create a new one or delete the existing document. 
 Q : Why in the Auto Issue section, WORK DONE 
 is not displayed ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 a Resource Requirement is created against work order (activity wise 
 lumpsum). Check and proceed with Auto Issue. 
 Q : How to remove Activities on Work 
 Order Amendment ? 
 Answer: If you 
 are unable to remove activities in the Work Order Amendment even after 
 saving/final approval, follow these steps: 
 a. In the next amendment, 
 open the activity, and find the "Action" dropdown. 
 b. 
 Change the dropdown selection to "DELETE." 
 c. Save the changes. 
 This will 
 allow you to delete the activities. 
 Q : Free Issue Material shows wrong 
 budget executed. What checks should the user undertake ? 
 Answer: Please 
 check the report of BUDGET VS ACTUAL report > BUDGET VALIDATION 
 REGISTER. 
 1. Check 
 the BOQ Material amount column. 
 2. Check the Resource Requirement Register Report 
 a. Select option type: Against BOQ (Co Efficient 
 Based) 
 b. Select BU & Sub Project and generate 
 the report. Filter the Budget Head. 
 Q : Why are the users unable to do the 
 Activity in BOQ ? 
 Answer: You cannot 
 edit Project Budget, BOQ if once an amendment has been done. 
 If you want to any increase / decrease of the same, follow the Amendment 
 process. 
 Q : What precaution should be taken 
 when discontinuing a Budget Group to avoid affecting other Budget Heads ? 
 Answer: Multiple 
 Budget Heads may be associated with one Budget Group. Verify the discontinue 
 action applies to the specific Budget Head rather than the entire 
 Budget Group. 
 Q: Does the Retention amount payable 
 reflect in the Retention Report and can it be released through the retention 
 money entry, if the Retention amount payable is updated in the Finance 
 Module opening balance? 
 Answer: No, the retention amount payable isn’t reflected 
 in the Retention Report if the retention amount payable is updated 
 in the finance module opening balance. 
 Q: How to view reports related 
 to Purchase Bill, Non-Store Purchase, and Contractor RA Bill, from a single 
 location? 
 Answer: In order to view all the reports at a single space, 
 navigate to Engineering> Report> Budget vs Actual> Budget 
 vs Actual Document Detail. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Q : Why are the users unable to do the 
 Activity in BOQ ? 
 Answer: You cannot 
 edit Project Budget, BOQ if once an amendment has been done. 
 If you want to any increase / decrease of the same, follow the Amendment 
 process. 
 Q : What precaution should be taken 
 when discontinuing a Budget Group to avoid affecting other Budget Heads ? 
 Answer: Multiple 
 Budget Heads may be associated with one Budget Group. Verify the discontinue 
 action applies to the specific Budget Head rather than the entire 
 Budget Group. 
 Q: Does the Retention amount payable 
 reflect in the Retention Report and can it be released through the retention 
 money entry, if the Retention amount payable is updated in the Finance 
 Module opening balance? 
 Answer: No, the retention amount payable isn’t reflected 
 in the Retention Report if the retention amount payable is updated 
 in the finance module opening balance.
